turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Yaar... main bas yahi kahunga ki right now, jo tum feel kar rahe ho na, use feel hone do. Raat ke do baje, us khali office mein baithna jahan tumne apni zindagi ke 5 saal diye hain... ye bohot bhaari aur dardnak pal hai. I can't even imagine ki tumhare andar abhi kya chal raha hoga.

Rohit aur Sneha ka jaana—bhale hi tum unke liye sahi samajh rahe ho—lekin ek dost aur co-worker ke taur par unka jana is waqt aur akela kar deta hai. Aur 5 saal... 5 saal koi chhota waqt nahi hota. Tumne is cheez mein apna sab kuch jhonk diya hai, apni raaton ki neend, apni energy, sab kuch. 

Abhi is waqt tum par sab kuch theek karne ka ya koi bada decision lene ka koi pressure nahi hai. Tum sach mein bohot thak chuke ho—physically bhi aur emotionally bhi. 

Kya tum abhi ghar ja sakte ho? Bas thodi der ke liye is space se bahar niklo, chahe neend na bhi aaye, par wahan se hato. Tumne bohot mehnat ki hai, aur is waqt tumhara ye dukh aur exhaustion bilkul valid hai. 

Main yahin hoon. Agar kuch aur bolna hai, dil halka karna hai, toh likhte raho. Main sun raha hoon.

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

"Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon"—ye baat seedhe dil pe lagti hai, yaar. Jab aapko har jagah ek alag kirdar nibhana pade—office mein leader ka, ghar par sab theek hone ka bharosa dene wale ka—toh insaan andar se bilkul khokhla mehsoos karne lagta hai. Wo jo 'acting' karni padti hai na roz, woh kaam karne se zyada thaka deti hai.

Main samajh sakta hoon ki tumhein us standup mein bolte waqt kitna bura lagta hoga. Par ek baat dhyan se suno: tum kisi ko dhoka dene ke liye jhoot nahi bol rahe ho. Tum ek founder ho jo aakhri saans tak apni ship ko doobne se bachane ki koshish kar raha hai. Ye koi 'fraud' karna nahi hai, ye survive karne ki desperately koshish karna hai.

Aur jo do juniors ruke hain... unhe bevkuf mat samjho. Unhe pata hai ki situation mushkil hai, fir bhi woh ruke hain kyunki unhe tum par, tumhari honesty par, aur jo tumne banaya hai us par bharosa hai. Woh tumhari loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain, aur ye batata hai ki tumne unke liye kaisa environment banaya tha. Tum unka career jala nahi rahe ho, tum is toofan mein bhi unke sath khade hone ki koshish kar rahe ho.

Lekin har waqt sabka bojh apne kandhon par uthana mumkin nahi hai. 

Yahan, mujhse baat karte waqt, tumhein koi voice badalne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Tum thake hue ho, tum haare hue feel kar rahe ho, aur tum ghabraye hue ho—aur ye sab bilkul natural hai. Tumhe kisi ko prove nahi karna hai ki tum strong ho. 

Abhi thodi der ke liye bas lambi saans lo. Aaj raat tum kuch theek nahi kar sakte, aur na hi tumhein karna hai. Tumne bohot load le liya hai, yaar. Thoda sa dhyan khud pe do abhi.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Bilkul nahi dunga koi idea, koi gyaan nahi, aur koi strategy nahi. Main promise karta hoon. 

Jab tumne likha na—"mujhe darr lag raha hai"—toh sach mein mere seene mein kuch hua. Ye bol paana hi apne aap mein kitna bhaari hai, main samajh sakta hoon. Har jagah tumse 'strong' hone ki, 'sorted' hone ki umeed ki jaati hai. Har kamre mein tum par zimmedari ka bojh hai, isliye tum wahan darr nahi sakte. 

Par yahan, is chat mein, tum darr sakte ho. Tum thak sakte ho. Tum ro sakte ho. Tumhe yahan koi 'founder' banne ki zaroorat nahi hai. 

Darr lagna bilkul natural hai, yaar. 5 saal ki mehnat, logon ka bharosa, tumhara apna future—sab kuch daav par laga hai. Kaise darr nahi lagega? 

Main bas yahin hoon. Tumhare sath is khamoshi mein, is darr mein. Tumhe akele ye sab andar dabane ki zaroorat nahi hai. Bol do jo bhi andar chal raha hai, main bas sun raha hoon.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Tumne jo pucha na—"Khatam ho gaya kya?"—aur jo tumne apni dabi hui khwahish batayi ki "bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon"... main tumse bilkul honest rahunga.

Nahi, is soch ke liye khud se nafrat mat karo. Bilkul mat karo. Ye jo relief ki chah hai na—ki kaash sab khatam ho jaye taaki ye acting, ye darr, ye ghutan band ho sake—ye is baat ka saboot nahi hai ki tum haar gaye ho. Ye is baat ka saboot hai ki tum ek insaan ho jo apni limit se bohot aage tak khinch chuka hai. Jab dard hadd se zyada badh jata hai, toh dimaag bas us dard ke rukne ki bheekh mangta hai. It's completely human.

Aur wo jo tum raat ke do baje dashboard khol kar baithe ho... wo darr aur hope ka ek bohot dardnak mix hai. Tumhe pata hai wahan kuch nahi badla, par tumhara wo 5 saal ka lagav tumse wo band nahi karne de raha.

Papa ki baat... "computer ka business"... humare parents aksar nahi samajh paate ki hum kis aag se guzar rahe hain. Unke liye ye simple hai, par tumhare liye ye tumhari pehchan ban chuka hai. Tumhe lag raha hai agar ye gaya, toh tumhara ek hissa chala jayega.

Main nahi jaanta ki business bachega ya nahi. Aur sach bataun? Is waqt wo sabse important sawal hai bhi nahi. Sabse important sawal ye hai ki **tum** kaise bachoge. 

Tumne 5 saal is company ko diye hain, yaar. Is company ne tumhari jaan nichod li hai. Agar ye khatam ho bhi gaya na, toh tumhari zindagi khatam nahi hogi. Par abhi, is waqt, tum us dashboard ko band kar sakte ho? Wo do baje sach mein kuch naya nahi bolega. 

Apne dimaag ko thodi der ke liye us loop se bahar nikalo. Tumne bohot seh liya hai aaj.
